**Finding: Compliant — no MFN obligation burdening us.**

I searched the agreement for every common MFN formulation (most favored/favoured, no less favorable, lowest price, best pricing, comparable, discount, other customers, preferred terms) and reviewed the likely homes for such language:

- **Section 4 (Fees)** — fixed license, maintenance/support fees, taxes and audit rights only; no pricing-parity undertaking.
- **Exhibit B (Pricing / Revenue Sharing Fees / Payment Terms)** — stated license, MarketSite.net access, maintenance, implementation amounts and a two-way revenue share (Commerce One pays Corio a share of MarketSite transaction fees; Corio pays Commerce One a share of Application Management Revenue, with carve-outs). No obligation to match or extend third-party terms.
- **Exhibit D (Sales and Marketing Cooperation)** — expressly non-binding, no pricing commitments.

There is no clause requiring Corio to offer Commerce One terms no less favourable than those given to others, so the preferred position is satisfied and no redline is proposed. Note there is also no Vendor-granted MFN in our favour; if you want one (e.g. best pricing on the revenue-share or access fees given the volume/revenue-based structure), that would be an affirmative ask rather than a defensive redline under this rule — flag it and I can draft it separately.
